items.title: How Ring Concierge is using the loose diamond social media trend to funnel buyers to its own channels
items.why: Trusted direct-to-consumer jewelry channels could suit affluent buyers, though no card angle is stated yet.
items.summary_ai: Ring Concierge is building a curated loose diamond buying channel as an alternative to social marketplaces like TikTok and eBay.
items.take: Trusted direct-to-consumer jewelry channels could suit affluent buyers, though no card angle is stated yet.
